stem.text: Which statement is **not** a reasonable estimate?

A.text: Atmospheric pressure at sea level is about $1 \times 10^{5}\,\text{Pa}$.

B.text: Light takes $5 \times 10^{2}\,\text{s}$ to reach us from the Sun.

C.text: The frequency of ultraviolet light is $3 \times 10^{12}\,\text{Hz}$.

D.text: The lifespan of a man is about $2 \times 10^{9}\,\text{s}$.
